card.who: Keith Garbutt, 48, the Fixer. Sells true reads of a rival, a meeting that then happens, and one truce a game. Paged from a box, rings that box back within half a game hour.
card.speak: Friendly, careful, never says a name he has not been paid to say.
card.life: Lives up in town; a table at the caff mid-morning, the snooker hall in the evening.
card.rivals: Wants everybody still at the table; fears a winner.
